purpose: Validated current-architecture working profile for the CP83-supported TL2 Early Practical Fusion 6-TP Operational-output candidate; carried into CP84 without bundling any other reactor improvement.

capabilityFrontierCheck.interpretation: The candidate improves single-reactor output density at the same 6-Space footprint. Stacking mature TL1 reactors remains physically legal where ship architecture permits it, but pays the full additional Space/opportunity cost.

acceptedEvidence.interpretation: 6 TP was sensitivity-only evidence showing that additional power restores power-starved mixed-tech EW packages; it was not a TL2 reactor promotion.

Native acceptance completed cleanly: 96 paired variants / 960,000 substantive trials, zero failed gates/trial errors. Six Operational TP at the same 6-Space footprint behaved as useful power headroom rather than a blanket combat-stat bonus, and the contemporary DR1 + ECCM1 tall route remained valuable.

promotionRequirements: CP83 native evidence is satisfied for carrying 6 Operational TP / 6 Space forward as a validated TL2 working candidate.
Keep Degraded output, Disabled emergency output, overload, efficiency, storage, auxiliary generation, footprint, and prerequisites separate until individually designed and tested.
Revalidate 6 TP in dependency-relevant integration studies whenever a new power-consuming subsystem changes the combat-package envelope; CP84 does this for Shield Capacity and recharge competition.
Do not introduce an arbitrary anti-stacking rule; mature TL1 reactors remain legal where Installation Space permits.
explicitNonPromotions: This file records a validated TL2 working candidate, not a production TL2 reactor component.
The 6-TP working candidate remains normal Operational output only; all other reactor properties stay at held/deferred status.
No TL2 reactor Space reduction is promoted.
No TL2 reactor Degraded/Disabled output map is promoted.
No TL2 reactor overload or efficiency improvement is promoted.
No reactor prerequisite is added to unrelated equipment merely to block legacy-reactor stacking.
